description: Selects one or more direct choices or complete cascading paths in a native or custom select-like control, automatically bringing the control into view and opening custom controls as needed.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select-like control.

id.description: Preferred canonical control ID from DOM.getAXTree or DOM.inspectSelect.

selector.description: CSS selector that must resolve to exactly one select-like control. Use a narrower selector or a canonical id when it matches multiple controls.

id.description: Opaque canonical option ID returned by DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getAXTree.

value.description: Exact option value, only when DOM.inspectSelect returned a value for that option.

label.description: Visible option label returned by DOM.inspectSelect.

path.description: Ordered cascade path from the root menu item to the final leaf option.

id.description: Opaque canonical option ID returned by DOM.inspectSelect or DOM.getAXTree.

value.description: Exact option value, only when DOM.inspectSelect returned a value for that option.

label.description: Visible option label returned by DOM.inspectSelect.

selections.description: Direct choices or complete cascading paths using fields actually returned by DOM.inspectSelect. A one-item array requests a single selection; multiple direct choices request multi-selection.

timeout.description: Maximum exploration time in seconds. Omit or pass 0 to use the 300-second default.

purpose.description: Describe the intended selected values, such as choosing a country, date, color, tags, or a root-to-leaf cascading location path.

purposeHint: Describe the intended selected values, such as choosing a country, date, color, tags, or a root-to-leaf cascading location path.
